notes: Customer profile: mid-market SaaS focused on contextual productivity experiences inside their app.
Primary ask: move from Hosted trial -> Dedicated for predictable latency & cost control.
Quote from CTO: 'We need sub-200ms p95 for quick inline suggestions or user bounce is high.'
Short-hand from POC: trial saw steady daytime QPS ~18, nightly lull to 3–5 QPS; spikes to 92 during product launch test.
They prefer an opinionated rollout: start dedicated for critical routes (autocomplete, chat), keep hosted for low-volume analytics jobs.
Security: must support SAML SSO for admin console, KMS integration for keys, and 1-year audit log retention.
Asked for: route-level telemetry, token-level cost breakdown, and a canary plan for model rollouts.
Drive artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VQ-pricing-deck (POC results + request for dedicated sizing)
Jira: INF-3241 (billing question), INF-3299 (latency anomaly during peak test)
use_case_summary: In-app conversational assistant (primary) + semantic document search and reranking for recommendations. Need deterministic latency for interactive flows and efficient batch embeddings for nightly indexing.
requirements: Latency: target p95 < 200ms for short-turn assistant responses (<= 256 tokens)
Throughput: baseline 30 QPS, peak 140 QPS (30-day peak forecast)
Cost sensitivity: mid-high, wants 12-month reserved pricing with burst capacity
Model flexibility: prefer open models with quantized variants; fallback chain required (fast small model -> higher-quality model)
Observability: per-route token/cost breakdown, traceable request ids, and alerts on quality regressions
qps_forecast: Observed Hosted trial (7 days sample): avg sustained QPS = 22 during business hours, nightly avg = 6, peak spike observed = 92 (stress test)
Customer forecast (product roadmap): expected 3x growth in 6 months -> projected baseline QPS = 66, peak QPS = 280; conservative sales forecast used = baseline 40 / peak 140
Traffic shape: 65% interactive generation, 25% search + reranking, 10% embeddings/indexing
Concurrency: typical concurrent open sessions estimated 45 normal, 120 peak (with 10–20 long-running embedding jobs scheduled off-peak)
token_mix: Interactive generation: median prompt tokens 48, median completion tokens 160 — avg roundtrip ~208 tokens
Search + reranking: typical calls return short completions (20–60 tokens) but are high-volume; average request ~80 tokens
Embeddings: nightly index jobs ~70k documents, avg 350 tokens per doc (batching applied)
capacity_sizing: Recommended Dedicated configuration (initial): 3 x mid-tier GPU nodes (equivalent to A10G-class throughput), autoscale policy to add 2 nodes on sustained 10-minute avg above 65 QPS. Configure two routing tiers: Dedicated for assistant and reranking routes, Hosted fallback for background analytics. Include prefix/KV caching and batching for embeddings to reduce token cost by estimated 28%. Estimated sustained token throughput ~3.5M tokens/hour at baseline; peak hourly ~12M tokens. Provide reserved pricing quote (12mo) + burst credits.
capacity_rationale: Sizing derived from 24h stress run and customer-provided session patterns
Caching + batching assumptions reduce effective GPU load for embeddings by ~30%
Desired p95 latency budget forces dedicated pool rather than pure hosted in-region fallback
commercial_notes: Initial ask: 12-month reserved commitment preferred; also asked for 6-month pilot/convert option
Legal: require DPA + data residency clause (US only) before signing
